address: No. 83, Doujiangwu, Nanlu Village, Moganshan Town, Deqing, Zhejiang, China

comments.quote: 這次出行選擇了山下這家民宿，入住體驗超出預期！民宿整體打理得十分整潔，房間乾淨清爽，細節之處都能看出店家用心。户外泳池水質澄澈，打理得乾乾淨淨，閑暇時間可以玩水放鬆。 民宿氛圍温馨治癒，老闆一家人熱情隨和，待人真誠，有任何需求都會耐心幫忙。店裡還養了兩三衹小狗和一衹小貓，小傢伙們温順親人，模樣軟萌可愛。小寶特別喜歡小貓貓，一直開心地和它們互動，增添了許多樂趣。 遠離喧鬧，環境清幽安靜，很適合家庭短途度假。不管是休閑發呆，還是帶孩子親近小動物都很合適。一次很棒的入住體驗，下次來周邊遊玩，還會優先考慮這家民宿。
comments.author: Guest User
comments.quoteEn: We picked this place at the foot of the hill and it was better than we expected. It is kept very tidy, the rooms are clean and fresh, and the care shows in the details. The outdoor pool is clear and properly maintained, so you can spend spare time in the water. The atmosphere is warm and restful, and the family who run it are friendly, easy going and honest, and will patiently sort out whatever you need. They keep two or three dogs and a cat, all gentle and soft natured. My little one was besotted with the cat and played with it constantly, which added a lot to the trip. It is away from the noise, quiet and secluded, and suits a short family break, whether you want to sit and do nothing or let a child get near some animals. A very good stay, and my first thought next time we are in the area.
